name: find_matching_table_record
description: Scans a table of 12-byte records, comparing the argument word with the record field at byte offset 6 and stopping at the first match or at a record whose following word is negative. It returns nothing.

name: find_slot_entry_by_key
description: Looks up the entry list for the slot index stored in the current object, then walks its 19-word entries comparing the argument word with each entry's key field until a match or the counted end. Nothing is stored or returned.

name: shift_position_toward_zero
description: For a record with zero motion words, returns its position field unchanged when the extent exceeds 200 or the height is greater than the width. Otherwise it returns that field moved 150 units toward zero.

name: resolve_mode_five_offset
description: Runs when the shared mode is five and the object carries a flag, computing an adjusted offset with a called routine. For large offsets it picks one of two follow-up actions based on the flag and the sign, setting the mode to one or to 255 and calling further routines.

name: set_mode_if_in_band
description: Returns its argument unchanged unless it lies inside a fixed numeric band. Inside the band it sets the shared mode to one and returns the results of two called routines.

name: compute_absolute_offset_sum
description: Adds the result of a called routine to the object's field 24, then takes the absolute value. When that value is at most 2048 it calls two further routines, and it returns the absolute value.

name: dispatch_handler_for_key
description: Stores the argument in the object's field 128, then searches a table of key and handler-offset pairs. A matching key calls the handler selected by its paired offset, and two cleanup routines run afterwards.

name: append_word_to_ring_buffer
description: Appends the argument word to a circular word buffer kept at a shared write index, wrapping the index to the buffer start past its end. A non-zero index first writes the index value into the buffer and calls a routine to produce the value stored.

name: wrap_ring_buffer_index
description: Clamps a buffer index to the start of its ring when it exceeds the upper bound, then saves its low word as the shared write index.

name: build_active_entry_key_list
description: Copies the key words of the entries attached to the selected object record into a work list, keeping entries that match the object's current flags. The list is terminated by a negative marker, and some entries trigger further routine calls.

name: store_slot_index_if_flagged
description: Reads the object's slot index, writes it through the output pointer, and also saves it to the shared slot word when that slot's record has flag bits 11 or 13 set.

name: search_active_key_list
description: Scans the active key list at a fixed address for the argument word, stopping at its negative terminator. The match position is not returned.

name: add_byte_to_unique_set
description: Adds a byte to a small set kept at a fixed address, skipping values already present. Values of twelve or more are first passed through a called routine, and the index of the new entry is saved.

name: match_slot_in_index_list
description: Searches a negative-terminated list of indices for the object's slot index. When the object is the currently selected one, it first resets a group of shared state values.

name: reset_state_and_scan_slots
description: Resets a group of shared state values, then scans the slot index list for the object's slot value until a negative terminator is reached.

name: scan_slots_then_reset_state
description: Scans the slot index list for the object's slot value and, on reaching the negative terminator, resets the same shared state values. It is the scan variant without an initial reset.

name: find_word_in_terminated_list
description: Walks a negative-terminated word list from the pointer register until it finds the argument word or reaches the terminator. Nothing is returned.

name: set_object_state_by_result
description: Clears one field of the object, calls a routine, then sets the object's state from the flag that routine leaves. On success it zeroes another field, stores the incoming pointer value and sets state code five; otherwise it stores a fixed constant and sets state code ten.

name: store_fallback_state_values
description: Stores a fixed constant in the object's field 58 and sets its state code field 42 to ten. It is the failure branch of the state setter above.

name: step_oscillating_value
description: While the object's direction-enable bit 12 is set, moves a stored value by 1536 units per call. It flips the direction bit 10 and reverses at the limits, then returns the updated value.

name: reset_object_to_state_nine
description: Sets the object's state code to nine, sets its countdown field to 16, and clears the top bit of its flag word. Nothing is returned.

name: update_object_state_on_threshold
description: When a motion flag is set and the object is not in a protected state, it counts down a delay field and otherwise checks a value from a called routine. A large value switches the object to a computed special state or saves the current state and moves to state fifteen.

name: step_coordinate_toward_target
description: Moves the object's position field toward a reference record's value by a step clamped to about 30 units, unless a flagged state blocks it. It then sets a timer to 30 and clears that timer when a called routine returns a value outside about plus or minus 200.

name: apply_clamped_step_and_timer
description: Adds a step to the object's position field, clamping very negative steps to minus 30, and sets a timer field to 30. It calls a routine and clears the timer when the returned value falls outside about plus or minus 200.

name: clear_timer_field
description: Sets the object's timer field to zero.

name: set_timer_to_1500
description: Stores the constant 1500 in the object's timer field.

name: integrate_object_motion_step
description: For objects with flag bit 13 set and bit 3 clear, adds a per-type speed from a table, scaled by the timer, to the object's position field. For the currently selected object it also advances a wrapping angle-like field by 28 times the timer.

name: raise_counter_to_type_limit
description: Raises the object's counter by 8, treating a negative value as zero, and caps the result at a per-type limit read from a table.

name: reset_object_and_dispatch_state
description: Resets the object's state code and countdown, copies its start position, and sets a timer chosen from its type field. It then either counts a flag-controlled counter, switching to state nine after fifty ticks, or clears it, and finally dispatches to the handler for the current state.

name: clear_counter_and_dispatch_state
description: Clears the object's counter and calls a few routines, with the set of calls depending on a shared flag and its state code. It then dispatches to the handler for the current state through a jump table.

name: reset_shared_selection_state
description: Calls two routines and then resets three shared state words to zero, 255 and minus one.

name: dispatch_by_index_jump_table
description: Calls the routine selected by the argument word from a jump table. The table could not be recovered, so the individual targets are not known.

name: read_sequence_word_or_dispatch
description: Reads the next word from the object's sequence pointer and returns it while it is non-negative. A negative word dispatches to a jump-table routine instead, and the selected object's special flags can return a fixed result first.

name: scan_list_for_repeated_head
description: Takes the first word of a negative-terminated list and scans forward for its next occurrence, returning when the list ends. The position of any repeat is left in the pointer register.

name: find_flagged_entry_index
description: Scans the object's entry list for an entry whose referenced record carries the special flag bits, lowers that record's counter to six when it is below seven, and returns that entry's index. If no entry qualifies it returns minus one.

name: choose_next_state_from_flags
description: Chooses the object's next state code from flag bits in its referenced record and its own flags, setting counters and state values for codes four, five, thirteen and fourteen. Otherwise it sets a timer to 1500, and in the remaining cases it dispatches to the handler for the chosen state.

name: walk_chain_then_select_state
description: Walks a chain of entries looking for a flagged one, and when none is found it compares the object's reference with the record and selects its next state the same way as its sibling routine. It dispatches to the handler of the chosen state at the end.

name: stub_return_only
description: A single return instruction with no work, reached from two places. It has no effect on the object.

name: record_target_and_set_timer
description: After a called routine, copies the argument word into an output record and sets its mode word to 8 or 1 by comparing it with a second word. When the object's reference field is not zero it sets the timer to 1500 instead.

name: set_timer_to_1500
description: Stores the constant 1500 in the object's timer field.

name: select_state_and_countdown
description: Copies the object's slot index into its reference field, then selects a state code from flag bits in the target's record and adjusts counters and flags. When the chosen state's countdown ends it dispatches to that state's handler.

name: mark_object_with_negative_delay
description: Stores minus twenty in the object's delay field 132 and sets flag bit 5 in its flag word. Nothing is returned.

name: advance_state_fourteen_countdown
description: Sets the object to state fourteen, then counts down its countdown field. When the count reaches zero and the reference differs from the object's target, it clears the timer and flag bit 5 and switches to state five; otherwise it sets the delay field to 20 and flag bit 5.

name: mark_object_with_positive_delay
description: Stores twenty in the object's delay field 132 and sets flag bit 5 in its flag word. Nothing is returned.

name: run_state_four_countdown
description: Checks the target record for blocking flags, setting a fixed timer if any are present. Otherwise it enters state four with a six-tick countdown, checks a called value against thresholds each tick, and switches to state five and dispatches when the countdown reaches zero.

name: run_state_four_without_check
description: Enters state four with a six-tick countdown and then behaves like its sibling state-four routine without the blocking-flag check. It switches to state five and dispatches when the countdown ends.

name: check_thresholds_and_reset_timer
description: Calls a routine and compares its result with thresholds: values above 600 clear the timer and set it to 1500, and values above 29 that fall outside plus or minus 32 clear the timer. The timer field is the only state it changes.

name: clear_timer_field
description: Sets the object's timer field to zero.

name: clear_timer_set_delay
description: Clears the object's timer field and stores 1500 in its delay field.

name: enter_state_five_and_dispatch
description: Sets the object's state code to five, calls two routines, and dispatches to the handler for state five through a jump table.

name: test_record_flags_for_state
description: When flag bit 10 is set, it reads the flag bits 11 and 13 of the referenced record and returns them masked. When no such bits are set it returns zero, and otherwise it clears a pending bit in the record.

name: begin_entry_state_transition
description: Clears a pending bit in an entry's record and, when the object's reference matches, either sets a fixed substate with a timer or moves the object to state five with a per-type counter. It returns the entry offset, or minus one when the transition is not taken.

name: copy_init_block_and_reset
description: Copies a block of thirty-six 4-byte values from a fixed source to a fixed destination, calls a routine, and then resets three shared state words.

name: select_action_from_shared_state
description: Returns a small action code decoded from the shared state word. It first counts down a delay, and otherwise it decodes the low five bits, with special cases that consult a table and a called routine to choose the action.

name: store_state_return_flag_bits
description: Stores the argument as the shared state word and returns flag bits 11 and 13 from the record that the argument indexes.

name: select_entry_for_object
description: Chooses an entry from the object's list, either the first one when its record has flag bit 14 set or the first entry matching the object's reference. It records the choice in the object's sequence pointer and sets state five.

name: count_down_and_restore_state
description: Decrements the object's countdown field. While it is still non-zero it sets the shared state word to 255 when the countdown is below five; when it reaches zero it restores the saved state code.

name: restore_saved_state_code
description: Copies the object's saved state code into its current state code.

name: pull_position_toward_limit
description: When flag bit 3 is set, moves the object's position field toward a target derived from a per-type value and the reference record, limiting each step to 20 units. It also sets the shared state word to 255 and returns the masked flag bit.

name: dispatch_sequence_command
description: Reads the next command word from the object's sequence pointer and calls the routine selected by that word from a jump table. The sequence pointer advances unless the word is zero.

name: advance_stage_when_timer_expires
description: Counts down the object's countdown field, and when it reaches zero advances a shared stage index capped at three. It then loads that stage's type, position and timer values and its flag bits from a stage table, with the timer set to 5372.

name: load_next_stage_parameters
description: Advances a shared stage index capped at three and copies that stage's type, position and flag values from a table into the object. It then sets the timer field to 5372.

name: check_band_and_set_timer
description: Clears the object's timer, then tests two computed values. Within about plus or minus 100 with the second value below 31 it clears the timer and returns minus one, and within that band otherwise it sets the timer to 40.

name: track_position_within_band
description: Stores a pair of values in a fixed table and checks whether a computed offset lies within about plus or minus 100. Inside the band it sets a timer to 25 and, when flag bit 3 is set and the distance is at most 200, moves the position field toward a target by at most 20 units.

name: invert_zero_test_result
description: Calls a routine and returns minus one when its result is zero, and zero otherwise.

name: compute_scaled_shared_offsets
description: When a shared mode word is non-zero and not 512, stores two scaled differences from fixed words into two shared outputs. Otherwise both outputs are set to 127.

name: apply_changed_indexed_values
description: Compares two indexed shared values with their previous copies and, when one changes, stores the new value and calls the routines that apply it. The second block runs a longer series of routine calls on change.

name: wrap_angle_difference_and_apply
description: Computes the difference between a shared value and a parameter, wrapped into a 168-unit cycle. When the wrapped result is within about plus or minus 22 it calls two routines and returns the first result.

name: apply_wrapped_difference_within_range
description: Computes the difference between a shared value and a parameter, wrapped into a 168-unit cycle. When the result is within about plus or minus 22 it calls two routines to apply it.

name: apply_wrapped_difference_within_range
description: Computes the difference between a shared value and a parameter, wrapped into a 168-unit cycle. When the result is within about plus or minus 22 it calls two routines to apply it.

name: update_byte_with_shadow_copy
description: Reads a byte from a record and, when it differs from its shadow copy in the indexed slot, stores the new value and calls routines to apply it. It returns the byte, or zero when that byte is the terminal zero value.

name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Calls a single routine and returns without changing anything itself.

name: reset_slot_table_entries
description: For each of five records spaced 24 bytes apart, sets its first word to 5632 when that record's marker word is non-negative.

name: sync_record_fields_with_mirror
description: Walks a table of 24-byte records up to a fixed end and, for each record whose field differs from its mirrored copy in the indexed slot, copies the value and calls a routine. Mismatched values are propagated this way.

name: clear_slot_flags_mark_object
description: Clears the low three flag bits in the first four 32-byte slot records, then sets flag bit 3 on the currently selected object.

name: reinit_slot_and_reset_object
description: Resets the current object's flag bits and two timer-like fields, then reinitializes the slot at the given index with a negative-one timer, flag bit 3 and a 256 delay field.

name: load_table_block_when_changed
description: Walks a set of entries and, when an entry's selector byte changes, copies a 16-row block of values from a fixed table into that entry's data area. It also syncs two other fields and calls routines when they differ.

name: reduce_slot_pool_or_spawn
description: Reduces four slot values in a fixed table by a scaled amount, and once the pool is exhausted it resets the shared state and initializes a fresh object record. Otherwise it subtracts the amount from a shared word and clamps that word at zero.

name: reduce_slots_then_init
description: Reduces four slot values by a step taken from a register and, when the remainder is non-zero, clears the shared state and initializes a fresh object record at fixed coordinates.

name: distribute_budget_across_slots
description: When the shared mode is active, counts the live slots below 6144 and takes a sixteenth of a running budget. It adds an equal share to each live slot and clamps the result at 6144.

name: add_step_to_active_slots
description: Stores the argument as a shared word and adds it to a value in each of four 32-byte slot records, clamping the total at 6144. A slot is skipped unless the shared word is non-zero or its flag byte is set.

name: scale_shared_value_by_eight
description: Returns the shared word multiplied by eight.

name: ensure_shared_value_nonzero
description: Sets the shared word to one when it is zero and leaves any other value unchanged.

name: step_frame_counter_sequence
description: Steps a small frame sequence stored in the record according to a shared mode number. Mode one advances a 4-bit counter and an index with wraparound, mode two reloads a countdown and moves the mode on, and other modes count down a 4-bit timer.

name: copy_mode_tables_into_entries
description: Fills a five-entry work array from a lookup table, using per-slot data or one of two byte tables depending on the shared mode. It then copies two 16-entry blocks into the object and applies a mask table to its fields.

name: call_routine_three_times
description: Calls a routine three times in a row and leaves the shared state unchanged.

name: call_routine_repeatedly
description: Calls a routine once for each step from the count register down to zero.

name: copy_defaults_on_mode_change
description: When a shared mode word is set, copies a block of default values into shared words and calls routines before clearing the mode word. Otherwise, when the indexed flag is zero, it sets that flag and calls a routine.

name: select_object_by_type_code
description: Looks up an object through the shared index and, when the object is valid and the shared value is large, selects it. It then runs routines that depend on whether the object's type code is 2544, and otherwise runs two fixed routines.

name: reset_entries_on_index_change
description: When the indexed byte differs from the shared value, stores the new value and resets four 12-byte entries to marker values, then calls a routine.

name: store_index_in_lookup_table
description: Writes the shared word into the lookup table slot selected by that same word, using four bytes per entry.

name: derive_shared_words_from_index
description: Stores the argument as a shared word, derives a second shared word from it by adding four or twelve, and loads a value from a lookup table indexed by the argument.

name: set_entry_marker_ten
description: Writes the value ten into the marker byte of the entry selected by the argument, using 12-byte entries.

name: set_entry_marker_five
description: Writes the value five into the marker byte of the entry selected by the argument, using 12-byte entries.

name: initialize_entry_markers_for_index
description: Stores the argument and sets a group of shared marker words to five or ten depending on whether the argument is one. It then writes five into the entry selected by the argument.

name: sync_marker_bytes_for_index
description: For two 12-byte records, copies a source byte into the indexed destination byte whenever they differ, and calls a routine on each change.

name: sync_marker_bytes_for_three
description: For three 12-byte records, copies a source byte into the indexed destination byte whenever they differ, and calls a routine on each change.

name: fill_marker_table_for_value
description: Fills a 16-entry marker table at a fixed address with ten. When the shared value is large it then writes five and a run of sixes, and otherwise it stops after the fill.

name: fill_marker_table_with_run
description: Fills the 16-entry marker table with ten, places five at a position from the shared value, and writes six into a run of positions counted down from a clamped value.

name: set_next_marker_from_flag
description: Advances a 4-bit index from a routine result and sets the marker at that index to five when a flag table entry is set, and to one otherwise.

name: store_marker_with_flag_check
description: Stores a byte into the marker table at the index held in the low four bits of the argument. A flag table entry for that index selects between the incoming value and a second register value.

name: sync_marker_shadow_for_index
description: Compares a marker byte in the table with its shadow copy at the shared index, and when they differ it stores the new value and sets the shared word to that value packed into both bytes. It then calls a routine that applies the change.

name: call_routine_sixteen_times
description: Calls one routine, then calls another routine sixteen times in a row.

name: clear_four_state_words
description: Clears four consecutive 32-bit state words to zero.

name: mark_slot_from_result_bits
description: Stores 255 in a flag table entry selected by the top four bits of a routine's result.

name: set_state_words_minus_one
description: Sets four consecutive 32-bit state words to minus one.

name: dispatch_nonzero_slot_flags
description: Combines the flag table entry at the argument's index with the entry eight positions further along, and calls a routine with the combined value when it is non-zero.

name: update_slot_values_and_average
description: Adjusts four slot values toward a shared target, clamping each between zero and 5632 and capping its contribution at 128. It then computes an average from the active slots and resets their per-slot counters.

name: call_six_routines_unresolved
description: Pseudo-code is unavailable because decompilation timed out, so only the call structure is recorded: 43 instructions, two callers and six called routines. Its purpose cannot be determined from the evidence.

name: call_two_routines_unresolved
description: Pseudo-code is unavailable because decompilation timed out, so only the call structure is recorded: 21 instructions, two callers and two called routines. Its purpose cannot be determined from the evidence.

name: dispatch_by_object_byte_table
description: Calls a routine selected through a jump table, indexed by the byte at offset 94 of the record in the address register scaled by eight.

name: dispatch_matching_table_entry
description: Searches a fixed table of three-word entries for one whose first two words match the object's type field and slot index. It calls the routine at the offset stored in the entry's third word.

name: dispatch_entry_with_base_offset
description: Searches a second fixed table of three-word entries for one matching the object's type field and slot index. It then calls the routine at the stored offset from a base register.

name: dispatch_keyed_table_entry
description: Walks a table of three-word entries from a pointer register, matching two key words. When a match is found it calls the routine at the stored offset from a base register.

name: call_offset_from_record
description: Calls the routine at a base address plus the word stored at byte offset four of the record in the address register.

name: set_shared_top_bit
description: Sets the top bit of the shared word and leaves the other bits unchanged.

name: set_shared_top_two_bits
description: Sets the two highest bits of the shared word and leaves the other bits unchanged.

name: clear_shared_top_two_bits
description: Clears the two highest bits of the shared word and keeps the rest.

name: sync_byte_fields_records
description: For four 24-byte records, copies a byte field into its shadow slot selected by the shared index whenever they differ, calling a routine on each change.

name: walk_list_until_negative
description: Walks a list of words from a stored pointer, calling a routine for each non-negative entry. It returns the negative terminator value that ends the walk.

name: append_word_to_small_queue
description: Appends the argument word to a three-slot queue indexed by a shared counter, then increments the counter. When the queue is full it resets the counter and clears its first marker word.

name: clear_shared_queue_state
description: Resets three shared words and one further shared word to zero.

name: clear_partial_shared_state
description: Clears two shared words and one further shared word to zero, then returns.

name: reset_shared_word_to_zero
description: Writes 255 and then zero into a shared word, leaving it zero.

name: update_flagged_record_bytes
description: When a shared flag bit is set, it either copies three record bytes into shared words or computes a scaled offset depending on the record's sign flag. It then sets three record bytes to two and returns a value, and otherwise it calls a routine and returns its masked result.

name: advance_sequence_from_table
description: When a shared countdown reaches zero, advances a small sequence held in four shared words, reading the next value from one of two byte tables selected by a shared index. It resets the sequence index when it runs past its length and returns the chosen value.

name: check_byte_thirteen_and_advance
description: Resets a shared word and calls two routines, then compares a byte read through a pointer with thirteen. On a match it clears the shared counter, increments it, and sets it to 1280, and otherwise it calls a routine while the counter is below 25.

name: toggle_shared_flag_and_notify
description: When the shared word is zero, inverts it and branches on the result. A zero result calls fifteen routines and sets the word to 255, and otherwise it clears the word and calls one routine.

name: call_fifteen_routines_then_reset
description: Calls fifteen routines, sets a shared word to 255, and then calls two more routines.

name: step_speed_toward_limit
description: Moves a per-object value toward a limit read from a table, using a shared step taken as half of a shared value on each call. For two specific object type codes it instead drains a stored value in steps of at most 192, and when the drain ends it changes the type code to 1296.

name: decay_five_counters_by_64
description: Subtracts 64 from a counter in each of five 24-byte records, clamping at zero.

name: call_one_routine_only
description: Calls one routine and returns without changing anything itself.

name: update_shared_timers_and_state
description: A long routine of 430 instructions that decrements several shared timers, branches on their values and calls fourteen routines to update state. The decompiled output was truncated, so the full behaviour cannot be recovered from the evidence.

name: dispatch_matching_list_entries
description: Walks the object's entry list and, for entries matching the shared index and flag fields, calls the routine selected from a fixed three-word table. It returns the last value it produced.

name: test_record_type_and_flags
description: Evaluates flag bits 5 and 11 of the record together with a set of type codes, but both branches return without changing any state.

name: test_flags_without_effect
description: Tests flag bits 5 and 11 of the record and returns in both cases, so it has no effect.

name: return_flag_status_code
description: When the record's byte at offset 94 is non-zero, returns minus one unless flag bit 9 is set, in which case it returns zero. Otherwise it returns the incoming value unchanged.

name: check_entries_within_extent
description: Walks a chain of entries and tests each entry's distance against a per-type extent, returning zero when an entry lies within it. It returns minus one when the search is exhausted or the entry count exceeds 300.

name: reset_two_shared_words
description: Writes zero into two shared words.

name: advance_counter_on_thirteen
description: When the argument is not thirteen it calls a routine if the shared counter is below 25 and then returns. For thirteen it resets the counter to zero, increments it, and sets it to 1280.

name: store_offset_from_two_words
description: Stores the two argument words in shared words and sets a third shared word to the second argument times 1280 plus the first times four.

name: process_null_terminated_text
description: Calls a routine for each byte of a zero-terminated text string and returns zero.

name: add_doubled_longword_to_shared
description: Doubles a 32-bit shared value, stores the doubled result in one shared longword, and adds it to another with carry propagation.

name: clear_byte_after_routines
description: Calls routines, sets a shared word to 255, and writes zero to the byte at the address register.

name: write_leading_zero_digit
description: Writes the low word of the argument as a decimal digit character, or a space while leading zeros are being suppressed, and returns the high word.

name: call_routine_if_nonnegative
description: Calls a routine only when the shared word is zero or positive.

name: call_routine_if_nonnegative
description: Calls a routine only when the shared word is zero or positive.

name: call_routine_if_nonnegative
description: Calls a routine only when the shared word is zero or positive.

name: call_routine_if_nonnegative
description: Calls a routine only when the shared word is zero or positive.

name: write_flags_to_bytes
description: Writes the value two into three consecutive bytes at the address register, calling a routine after each write. It then sets shared words to 8, zero and 255.

name: lookup_masked_table_byte
description: Calls a routine and uses its result to index two tables, then returns a byte from a third table XORed with a constant.

name: lookup_table_byte_with_offset
description: Calls a routine for an index, adds a stored offset, and wraps the sum against a limit. It returns a byte from a table XORed with a constant.

name: advance_counter_on_byte_match
description: Copies a longword between two pointers and compares a table byte with an expected byte. A match advances a shared counter and, when a flag byte is clear, sets a shared word to 255; otherwise the counter is cleared.

name: advance_counter_on_byte
description: Compares the low byte of the argument with an expected byte held in a shared counter table. A match advances the counter and, when a flag byte is clear, sets a shared word to 255; otherwise the counter is cleared.

name: call_eighteen_routines_unresolved
description: Pseudo-code is unavailable because decompilation timed out, so only the call structure is recorded: 118 instructions, one caller and eighteen called routines. Its purpose cannot be determined from the evidence.

name: dispatch_keyed_handler_table
description: When the shared word is non-zero, scans a table of six-byte records for a key matching it. On a match it clears the shared word and calls the routine whose address is stored in that record.

name: clear_shared_and_call_handler
description: Clears a shared word and calls the routine whose address is stored at offset two of the record in the address register.

name: program_blitter_for_span
description: Computes a span width and height from two clamped coordinate words, then programs the blitter control, mask, modulo, pointer and size registers. It waits for the blitter to be idle before each register write.

name: program_blitter_span_registers
description: Computes a span from two clamped coordinate words and programs the blitter control, mask, modulo, pointer and size registers. It waits for the blitter to be idle before each write.

name: call_routine_while_byte_nonzero
description: Calls a routine repeatedly while the byte at the address register is non-zero, then returns zero.

name: poll_until_flag_set
description: Repeatedly calls a routine and then a second routine until a flag the first routine sets becomes true, then returns.

name: copy_block_to_alternate_buffer
description: Chooses one of two buffer addresses as the target, advances it by 4096 bytes, and copies 2000 longwords from a source offset by 32768 bytes into it.

name: unpack_literal_and_backref_stream
description: Unpacks a compressed stream in which a non-negative control byte copies that many literal bytes and a negative one copies a run from an earlier offset. A control value of minus one ends the stream.

name: unpack_stream_with_inline_control
description: Unpacks a compressed stream using the same control scheme, with the control byte read inline from the stream. It returns zero when the stream ends with a zero-length marker.

name: unpack_control_stream_loop
description: Loops over a compressed stream, copying literal runs for non-negative control bytes and back-referenced runs for negative ones. It returns zero when the end marker is reached.

name: call_three_routines_in_order
description: Calls three routines in sequence and returns.

name: call_three_routines_in_order
description: Calls three routines in sequence and returns.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

name: copy_table_init_shared_words
description: Copies 8001 longwords from one buffer to two destinations and calls two routines. It then fills a block of shared words with a value derived by halving a shared word.

name: init_shared_word_block
description: Derives a value from shared words by halving it, fills nine shared words with that value, and copies one further shared word into the block.

name: build_scanline_span_list
description: Scans outward from two start positions, testing a value from a called routine until it differs from two. Each resulting pair is recorded in an output list with a count header.

name: record_span_pairs_until_gap
description: Records start and end pairs into an output list while scanning, stopping when the start passes the end. The pair count is stored in a header.

name: clear_three_shared_words
description: Writes zero into several shared words and leaves the others unchanged.

name: combine_three_results
description: Repeats 512 times, calling a routine three times and storing the bitwise AND of the three results through the output pointer.

name: return_value_after_reset
description: When the shared word is non-negative, it calls a routine, resets the shared word to 99, and returns the result of a second routine. Otherwise it returns the shared word unchanged.

name: update_byte_pair_from_indices
description: Runs seven passes that check a table byte selected by a routine's result and, when that byte is set, write a value from a second routine into the table. It finally copies two bytes from fixed offsets within the entry.

name: initialize_slot_tables
description: Resets four records and seven 12-byte entries to fixed marker values, and fills sixteen table entries with minus-one markers. It then writes an alternating pattern into four 32-byte slot records.

name: reset_state_from_pending_byte
description: When the pending byte in the indexed record is negative, copies it into a second byte of that record. It then clears a word field and sets the shared word to 255.

name: call_fixed_then_routine
description: Calls a fixed routine and then a further routine, then returns.

name: call_fixed_then_repeat
description: Calls a fixed routine once, then calls another fixed routine repeatedly while the count register is non-zero.

name: call_sequence_with_fixed_step
description: Calls two routines, then a fixed routine, then three further routines in order.

name: wait_for_command_then_restore
description: Saves three shared words, then waits for a shared byte to become non-zero and reads it as a command code. Certain codes run a fixed call sequence, and the saved words are restored before the routine returns.

name: call_fixed_routine_only
description: Calls one fixed routine and returns.

name: add_argument_to_shared_word
description: Adds the second argument word to a shared word.

name: store_routine_address_shared
description: Calls a routine, stores the address of another routine in a shared word, and then calls a third routine.

name: call_routines_conditionally_on_shared
description: When the shared word is non-zero, calls a routine, then calls a second routine with the first argument only when the address register is zero.

name: call_routine_if_shared_nonzero
description: Calls a routine only when the shared word is non-zero.

name: update_audio_channel_registers
description: Steps eight 32-byte channel records using a pseudo-random feedback value, then writes the period and volume registers of the four audio channels. The decompiled output was truncated, so only the visible part is described.

name: initialize_audio_channels
description: Fills a sample buffer with a pseudo-random pattern, sets the pointer, length, period and volume registers of the four audio channels, and clears the channel state. It then calls a routine.

name: store_channel_command_fields
description: For an index below 99, looks up a channel slot through a table and stores the masked second argument in it. The index is also stored unless bit 14 of the second argument is set.

name: store_channel_command_fields
description: For an index below 99, looks up a channel slot through a table and stores the masked second argument in it. The index is also stored unless bit 14 of the second argument is set.

name: store_channel_command_fields
description: For an index below 99, looks up a channel slot through a table and stores the masked second argument in it. The index is also stored unless bit 14 of the second argument is set.

name: configure_audio_dma_channels
description: Writes the audio control, pointer, length, period and volume registers for all four channels, then writes the DMA control register to enable audio DMA. It calls 21 routines along the way.

name: run_fixed_call_sequence
description: Calls about twenty-eight routines in a fixed sequence, branching on a shared word to make a few extra calls, then calls a final fixed routine.
